title: Welcome to OpenSRD
subtitle: Your Ultimate Resource for the System Reference Document
content: OpenSRD is a comprehensive web application designed to provide easy access to the System Reference Document (SRD) for tabletop role-playing games. Whether you're a player, game master, or content creator, OpenSRD offers a user-friendly interface to explore spells, items, NPCs, and more. Dive into the world of your favorite RPG with OpenSRD as your guide!
